methodology.snapshot_policy: Use retained direct-HTTP Murlok snapshots, not mixed later web index rankings. Filtered Farseer and overall have the same 50 members.
methodology.time_semantics: UTC ISO timestamps; direct-HTTPS retrieved_at is request-start time. Browser retrieved_at is DOM extraction time or fetch request-start time.
methodology.sample_unit: Unique current character PvE API gear snapshot ranked by M+ score; not damage logs, not necessarily gear used in the best run.
methodology.population_warning: Do not compute 50/(50+8) as global hero-tree share. The two pages are separately filtered capped samples.
methodology.percent_denominator: Each item count divided by number of characters; dual-slot categories may sum to 200%.
methodology.omissions: Website limits visible gear rows in some slots. Coverage is retained per slot; do not assign zero to an absent item in an incomplete category.
methodology.stats_warning: Murlok percentages are rounded integers; buff state and rounding method are not established. Do not convert percentages to ratings or treat page optimal stats as a target/cap.
methodology.tier_warning: Displayed tier item ID/name does not establish original item, inherited stats, cantrip, item level, upgrade track or bonus IDs.
methodology.craft_warning: Explicit Craft badges plus individually shown embellishment hosts establish the documented crafting rows. Missing badges are not proof of non-crafted origin.
methodology.availability_warning: Top-player observed versions can exceed the user acquisition ceiling. Candidate IDs must be rebuilt with legal H+R+/M+/Vault/craft bonuses; no 9/6 copied.

author_guides.author: Celz
author_guides.equipment_advice: Trinket shortlist: 273796, 281215, 270164, 250215, 270167. Long term: two Arcanoweave Linings; cloak is worth considering when Mythic raid cloak access is excluded.
author_guides.freight_timing_advice: 250215 has a 90-second cooldown; author suggests holding 30 seconds when pairing with a two-minute Ascendance.
author_guides.caution: Some item hyperlinks still target PTR/ptr-2. IDs were cross-checked against the live Wowhead guide where possible; linked PTR tooltips were not used as live build proof.

author_guides.author: Stormy
author_guides.stat_advice: Intellect is primary; secondary order Mastery > Haste > Critical Strike > Versatility.
author_guides.equipment_advice: S tier includes 281215, 270164, 250215, 270167, 273796. 270170 is A tier and described as a Mythic+ option. Craft 244584 plus a suitable armor slot with two Linings.
author_guides.catalyst_advice: Guide explicitly recommends 271876 as the chest precursor and states that catalysis retains its cantrip; this does not identify any sampled player precursor.

author_guides.author: HawkCorrigan
author_guides.stat_advice: Gear page: Mastery > Haste = Critical Strike >> Versatility; substantial Intellect/item-level gains matter. Stats page lists 1200 Mastery rating, then Haste/Crit for both trees.
author_guides.equipment_advice: Displayed trinket table: 281215/270164/250215/273796 at S, 270170 at B. Recommends two Linings on 244577 and 244584.
internal_cautions: Stats prose mentions 72%, a soft-cap discussion and Root Warden's Regalia; the gear page instead recommends two Arcanoweave Linings. Do not transfer the Root Warden condition to the current setup.
Stats ordered list places Intellect last, contrary to the gear page's item-level explanation. Preserve as a source inconsistency, not a character weight.
The captured trinket text did not establish the selected mode tab as Mythic Plus; S/B labels are retained as displayed, not asserted as a verified M+-filtered table.

catalyst_candidates.cantrip_effect_provenance: The chest-retention claim is from the Icy guide, not inferred from the five displayed 271486 tier items.

character_assessment.stat_comparison: 24.24% crit / 24.02% haste / 62.08% mastery / 2.24% versatility broadly overlaps the top-five rounded displays. This is not evidence of a fixed missing stat target.
character_assessment.rating_comparison: No current character ratings were supplied; no reverse conversion was attempted.
character_assessment.tier_comparison: User confirmed five tier pieces. A single ordinary off-piece substitution is eligible for a four-piece-preserving comparison; do not replace a second tier slot without checking the actual four-piece.
